goal: Bound orphan transaction memory usage so attackers cannot inflate a node's real memory far past intended caps
Fixes a case where witness-heavy orphans can use up to 28x their accounted weight in memory

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it closes a real memory-amplification DoS vector in core orphan handling
A standard-weight orphan can use 28x its accounted weight, retainable once per peer, letting an attacker inflate node memory
Review itself surfaced and fixed a second amplification bug in the same code, showing how load-bearing this area is for DoS resistance
